executors.description: Compute reproducible numerical facts from raw series rows already returned by mysql-steel-data. It supports, but does not replace, the LLM's methodology-led market analysis.

actions.description: Required after every mysql-steel-data series query that will support a user-facing trend or numerical conclusion. Profiles the actual series shape, including date-level value sets, single-value changes when defensible, range-boundary movement for same-date multi-value data, coverage, and data-quality facts. It does not select the business methodology.

inputs.name: input-file
inputs.description: The persisted Run-workspace JSON artifact for one mysql-steel-data query-series result, including one acquired through locate-series.

actions.result: Per-scope numerical and data-quality facts plus evidenceReceipt.deliveryFacts. Accepts one query-series receipt or an execute-query-plan result. Use single-value changes only for unique endpoints; otherwise use dailyProfiles and endpointRangeMovement.
